quirks.summary: PlanIt's auths match for 'Warwick' also returns NORTH Warwickshire, a different council on a different product.
quirks.detail: Seen 2026-09-30. North Warwickshire is DEF Atrium at planning.northwarks.gov.uk/Search/Results/; Warwick District is Idox at planningdocuments.warwickdc.gov.uk. Taking the first PlanIt row would put you on the wrong council's register.
quirks.workaround: Match the authority name exactly against the PlanIt row before using its planning_url.
